from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime
import requests
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1'
assert not (OUT/'original_announcement_probe.json').exists(),'原公告核对已有记录，不能重复。'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,d):(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raw=json.loads((OUT/'fiscaldata_auction_query_raw.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
records=raw['data'];first=records[0]
allowed=['cusip','security_type','security_term','original_security_term','auction_date','issue_date','maturity_date','announcemt_date','offering_amt','xml_filenm_announcemt','pdf_filenm_announcemt']
projection=[{k:r[k] for k in allowed} for r in records]
save('公告候选白名单样例.json',{'status':'SOURCE_PROBE_ONLY_NOT_TRAINING_INPUT','allowlist':allowed,'rows':projection,'all_other_103_result_or_auxiliary_fields_excluded':True,
 'field_means':'offering_amt是公布总规模，不是净新增资金；original_security_term不是此次剩余期限，续发需分别识别。',
 'historical_first_vintage_verified':False})
spec={'url':'https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov/static-data/published-reports/auctions-query/announcements/'+first['xml_filenm_announcemt'],'max_requests':1,'selection':'固定查询首条，未查看股票收益。'}
save('original_announcement_probe_registration.json',{'at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'source_spec':spec,
 'whitelist_frozen_before_any_model_fit':True,'new_model_fits':0})
result={'source_spec':spec,'retrieved_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'status':'NOT_ADMITTED','model_ready':False}
try:
 response=requests.get(spec['url'],timeout=(10,20),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
 result['http_status']=response.status_code;response.raise_for_status()
 tree=ET.fromstring(response.content)
 p=OUT/first['xml_filenm_announcemt'];p.write_bytes(response.content)
 leaves=[{'tag':n.tag.split('}')[-1],'text':n.text.strip()} for n in tree.iter() if len(n)==0 and n.text and n.text.strip()]
 result.update(status='ORIGINAL_XML_AVAILABLE_SOURCE_CLOCK_PENDING',source_path=p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
               source_sha256=sha(p),xml_root=tree.tag,original_leaf_fields=leaves,
               expected_announcemt_date=first['announcemt_date'],expected_offering_amt=first['offering_amt'],
               expected_issue_date=first['issue_date'],future_auction_results_used=False)
except Exception as error:result.update(error=str(error)[:500])
save('original_announcement_probe.json',result)
print('原公告探针：'+result['status'])
if result.get('original_leaf_fields'):
 print(json.dumps([x for x in result['original_leaf_fields'] if any(k in x['tag'].lower() for k in ['date','amt','amount','time','cusip','term','security'])],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)[:4500])
